Guhagararira abanda bajyanama mu nama zatumijweho n’inzego zitandukanye Kumenya umujyanama w’ubuzima wahagaritse akazi, agakurikirana ibikoresho yakoreshaga niba byose byagaruwe ku kigo nderabuzima, kandi agahita abimenyesha ikigo nderabuzima. Ubushishozi mu Gufata icyemezo no kukibwira umurwayi.
Ni ingenzi cyane gufata umwanya ugatega amatwi witonze, kugirango ufashe umuntu kunyura mubihe bikomeye arimo. Mukuvuga ibyababayeho, bibafasha kumva neza ibyabayeho bakanabyakira. Uku kugabanuka kw’abarwara Malariya y’ igikatu bijyana no kugabanuka kw’abarwayi bicwa na Malariya bishingiye ku ngamba zashyizweho harimo kuba Malariya isuzumwa kandi ikavurwa hakiri kare umurwayi atararemba, ndetse n’izindi zigamije kugabanya ikwirakwira rya malariya nko kuryama mu nzitiramibu zikoranye umuti, gutera imiti yica imibu mu mazu ndetse no kwigisha abaturage gukuraho indiri imibu yororokeramo.
Mufatanyije n’umutoza, mukore uyu mwitozo. Keza Anita wavutse ku itariki ya mbere mutarama 2008, atuye mu mudugudu wa Muhoza, akagari ka Muhoza mu murenge wa Muhoza akarere ka Musanze, amaze ukwezi n’ibyumweru bitatu afite umuriro akababara no mu gatuza, imiti yose yafashe ntacyo yamumariye. Mu mwaka wa 2018 ukwezi k’ ugushyingo, umuturanyi wabo yarwaye igituntu aravurwa arakira. Keza afite ibiro bike ugereranyije n’imyaka ye n’uburebure afite. Nk’umujyanama w’ubuzima akugezeho ku itariki ya 15 werurwe 2020.

2.Ni ibihe bikorwa umujyanama w’ubuzima yafasha umuryango mu bijyanye n’imyiteguro yo kubyarira kwa muganga ?
Mujye mu matsinda y’abantu batanu maze mujye ku kigo nderabuzima, murebe raporo zoherejwe ku kigo nderabuzima n’abajyanama b’ubuzima, murebe uburyo bujuje ifishi imenyekanisha urupfu rw’umubyeyi cyangwa umwana uri munsi y’imyaka itanu rutabereye kwa muganga. Hanyuma mukore raporo y’ibyo mwabonye muraza kubisangize abandi.

Uburyo bwa kanguru ni ugufatira umwana mu gituza umubiri ku mu biri ibyo bitera umwana ubushyuhe kandi bigakuza urukundo hagati y’ umwana na nyina.

20. Kumenya igitabo cy’amafishi ikigonderabuzima gikoresha mu kugenzura imikorere y’abajyanama
1. Gusobanura akamaro ko gukangura ubwonko bw’umwana kuva agisamwa
Icyitonderwa: Umwana akura mu byiciro binyuranye mu gihagararo, mu bwonko, mu marangamutima, mu kuvuga, no gukoresha ingufu. Twibutse ko abana bose badakura kimwe; Ntibizagutangaze uwawe yujuje umwaka atarahaguruka ariko azi kuvuga, mu gihe uwo umuturanyi yujuje umwaka azi kuvuga ariko na we agikambakamba. Buri mwana agira icyo akuramo vuba, n’icyo atinda gukuramo. Ibyo tuvuze muri rusange biba mu mwaka wa mbere. Ariko nk’abana bavutse batagejeje igihe, kimwe n’abafite ibibazo by’ubuzima cyangwa bavukanye ubumuga runaka batinda gukura.

IMBUMBE YA 1: KUMENYA UBUZIMA BWO MU MUTWE
Umujyanama w’Ubuzima agomba kumenya no gusobanukirwa uburyo imyumvire n’imyitwarire yahindutse mu miryango no mu baturage muri rusange. Ibi bishobora gukorwa mu buryo bw’ubuhamya butangwa n’abaturage bahinduye imyumvire ndetse n’icyo bungutse mu muryango; bagatangira ubwo buhamya mu nama rusange cyangwa mu matsinda mato.
Gukaraba intoki ukoresheje isabune n’amazi meza asukiriwe mbere yo gutegura amafunguro na mbere yo kugaburira umwana
Gutondagura ibikorwa bishobora gucamo uruhererekane rw’imirire mibi mu mpinja, abakobwa, abangavu n’abagore.
Mu mwaka w’ 1998, Minisiteri y’ Ubuzima mu Rwanda yashyizeho uburyo bwo gucunga amakuru y’ ubuzima mu rwego rwo koroshya ihanahana ry’amakuru y’ubuzima.

Mu matsinda y’abantu babiri, muvuge imyitwarire iranga utanga ikiganiro ku nyigisho zo kuboneza urubyaro ku rwego rw’umudugudu. Nimumara kubyandika, mujye mu mudugudu muturanye murebe uko umujyanama atanga ikiganiro. Mwandike ibyo mubonye kubijyanye n’imyitwarire umujyanama yagaragaje, hanyuma muze kubisangiza abandi.

Indwara zo mu buhumekero ni indwara zifata mu bihaha. Zishobora gufata mu buryo bworoshye zikavurwa, ariko zishobora no gukomera zikaba zavamo icyorezo. Bimwe mu bituma zavamo icyorezo ni uburyo zikwirakwizwa ku buryo bwihuse cyane cyane ahantu haba abantu babana begeranye cyane. Izi ndwara zandura binyuze mu matembabuzi (droplets) anyura mu mwuka iyo umuntu yitsamuye cyangwa akoroye. Uburyo rusange bwo kuzirinda bushingiye ku Guhindura imyumvire n’imyitwarire (Gupfuka umunwa igihe akorora cg yitsamuye, gukoresha udutambaro twabugenewe yisukura mu mazuru,....), kugabanya ubucucike bw’ahantu hatuwe ndetse no kwivuza hakiri kare cyane cyane ku bana bafite ibimenyetso mpuruza harimo guhumeka bigoranye

Icyorezo ni ukugaragara kw’indwara mu gace no mu gihe runaka ku buryo butari busanzwe. Agace kagaragawemo indwara n’igihe yagaragariyemo bigomba kuba bizwi. Umubare w’abarwaye ugenda uhindagurika bitewe n’agakoko kayiteye n’abaturage bagezweho n’indwara. Icyorezo gishobora kugaragara mu gace runaka, mu gihugu runaka ndetse kugeza no ku rwego rw’umugabane cyangwa rw’isi
Uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro butangwa mu mudugudu
Buri mwaka abantu barenga miliyoni eshanu mu Rwanda bashobora kujya mu bitaro bakeneye ubufasha cyangwa ubuvuzi ku bibazo by’ubuzima bitunguranye kandi bitandukanye. Ibi bibazo bishobora kuba uburwayi, ibikomere byoroheje kugera ku bibazo bitunguranye bikomeye bishobora kuba byatwara ubuzima bw’umurwayi cyangwa se inkomere.Ubutabazi bw’ibanze butangira mu gihe umuntu uri kumwe n’uwagize ikibazo cy’ubuzima gitunguranye ariwe uhamagara umujyanama w’ubuzima cyangwa undi muntu ushobora gutanga ubutabazi bw’ibanze. Binyuze m’ubutabazi butangwa n’ishami ry’imbangukiragutabara, uwagize ikibazo agezwa kukigo nderabuzima, ku bitaro by’akarere ndetse n’ibitaro bya kaminuza bimwegereye kugirango ahabwe ubuvuzi cyangwa ubufasha bwisumbuyeho.
N’ubwo umujyanama w’Ubuzima abagomba gusura buri mugore wo mu mudugudu atuyemo utwite inshuro 3 mu gihe atwite, umujyanama w’Ubuzima nta bufasha bw’ubuvuzi atanga.

Ibigenderwaho mu guhitamo ahatangirwa inyigisho y’umunsi
Kubaza igihe umwana yafatiwe ni ingenzi kugirango umujyanama w’ubuzima abashe gusuzuma umwana urwaye, kuku iyo amaze igihe kirenze icyumweru arwaye umujyanama ahita amwohereza kwa muganga. Ibibazo bikurikira bifasha umujyanama w’ubuzima kumenya uko ibimenyetso by’uburwayi bimeze n’igihe umwana yafatiwe mu minsi: Kubaza itariki ibimenyetso bya mbere byagaragaye Kubaza uko ibimenyetso byagiye byiyongera Kubaza uko ibimenyetso byagiye bikurikirana Kubaza niba ntawundi wo mu muryango wagize ibyo bimenyetso.

Icyena mu mbavu
Mu mudugudu wa Nyarurembo, umujyanama w’ubuzima Mariko yatanze ikiganiro mu rubyiruko kirebana n’ubuzima bw’inyororokere. Urubyiruko rumubaza imyanya myororokero ku mugabo no ku mugore iyo ariyo. Abasubiza ko ku mugabo iy’inyuma ari imboro naho iy’imbere ari amabya. Ku mugore abasubiza ko mu y’imbere ari umwenge w’inda ibyara mu y’iyinyuma abasubiza inkondo y’umura.
Ku munsi wa gatatu kavutse Umujyanama w’Ubuzima yasuye Esteri anasuzuma ko nta bimenyetso by’uburwayi agahinja gafite. Kubera ko agahinja kari gato (kwa muganga bari basanze gafite 2,100kg) Umujyanama yashishikarije Esteri kujya yonsa ako gahinja ku manywa na nijoro nyuma ya buri masaha 2 kandi ntagire ikindi agaha. Umujyanama kandi yamweretse uko azajya akarinda imbeho akiyegereza kenshi kumubiri.

Bumwe mu buryo bwizewe bufasha gutahura no kuvura abarwaye Malariya hakiri kare, harimo no kwegereza kandi bizewe n’abaturage babitoreye. Muri urwo rwego rero, mu mwaka wa 2016, abajyanama b’ ubuzima bari basanzwe bavura Malariya abana gusa bahuguriwe no kuvura abantu bakuru. Ibyo byatumye imibare y’abarwayi ba Malariya bivuza ku Mujyanama w’ ubuzima uva ku barwayi 13% mu mwaka wa 20152016 ugera ku barwayi 57% mu mwaka 20182019 ugereranyije n’abarwayi bose bivuje Malariya mu Rwanda. Iyi mibare rero igaragaza uruhare rw’abajynama b’ubuzima mu kugabanya Malariya y’igikatu ndetse n’impfu ziterwa na Malariya.

Ni agakoko gato cyane katagaragara n’amaso kandi gatera indwara. Gashobora kuba Virusi, mikorobe, bagiteri n’ibindi. Muri rusange, ako gakoko gatera indwara ni ingenzi kugirango icyorezo kibeho; ariko ko konyine ntabwo gahagije kugirango gatere icyorezo; niyo mpamvu hari ibindi bikenerwa kugirango umuntu wanduye agakoko agaragaze ibimenyetso by’indwara. Muri ibi harimo ubushobozi bw’agakoko bwo gutera indwara, ndetse n’ingano (dose) y’udukoko.

Kuruka n’isesemi

MU MUDUGUDU ....
1) Ni izihe ngaruka z’akato ku bantu?
Kuboneza urubyaro bituma na Leta yoroherwa mu gutanga serivisi rusange nk’amavuriro, amashuri, amashanyarazi, amazi, n’imihanda. Ibi bituma serivisi zirushaho gutangwa neza mu mavuriro no mu bitaro, amashuri akarushaho kuba meza hari abana bacye muri buri cyumba cy’ishuri, imihanda ikubakwa, indi igasanwa.
1. Ni akahe kamaro ko kubyarira kwa muganga ku mugore utwite ?

Ubwangavu ni iki ?
Ikimenyetso mpuruza ni ikimenyetso cyerekana ko ubuzima bw’umwana buzahajwe n’indwara, ko ashobora kuba akeneye byihutirwa ubuvuzi bwo ku Kigo nderabuzima cyangwa ku bitaro. Ku mujyanama w’ubuzima hiyongeraho ibindi bimenyetso by’indwara atemerewe kuvura cyangwa bitari mu nshingano ze.

Mugihe umwana amaze gukira, Umubyeyi abyitayeho amushishikariza kurya buri munsi igaburo rigizwe n’ indyo yuzuye mugihe cy’ ibyumweru bibiri. UBUZIMAInkororan’ibicurane
Inama n'amabwiriza bihabwa umurwayi ku muti umwana cg umurwayi ahawe. Muhe ingano fatizo ya mbere y'umuti kandi umusobanurire uko azajya afata umuti mu rugo akurikije intambwe zose nkuko wazimweretse. Musobanurire ko umuti wa malariya (ArtemeterLumefantrine) ufatanwa n'ibiryo cg ibinyobwa cyane cyane ibifite ibinure (amata,....) Mubwire igihe agomba gufata ingano fatizo y'umuti ikurikiraho Musobanurire ko uwo muti wagenewe kuvura iyo ndwara kandi ko iyo awufashe neza umukiza. Gusobanurira umurwayi akamaro ko gufata umuti akarangiza ingano fatizo zose yandikiwe, mu gihe gikwiriye. Birabujijwe gusangira umuti, niba hari undi muntu mu rugo urwaye, mujyane ku mujyanama w'ubuzima. Bwira umurwayi ko niba akomeje kuremba mu minsi 2 uhereye igihe yatangiriye imiti agomba kugaruka ku mujyanama w'ubuzima. Sobanurira umurwayi ingaruka zishobora guterwa n'umuti ariko ko zishira, nazibonaho azaze ku mujyanama w'ubuzima.

Umusaruro w’inyigisho 2.4: Gushaka udukoko dutera malariya mu maraso no gutanga ibisubizo

Vuga uruhare rw’abagabo n’abandi bagize umuryango mu gukangura ubwonko bw’umwana kuva umwana agisamwa? Umugabo agomba gukuyakuya inda umwana akiri munda, kuririmbira umwana uri munda uturirimbo dutuje, ibihozo n’ibindi kuko bituma ubwonko bukanguka byihuse kukigero cya 80% muminsi 1000 gusa. Kuba hamwe n’umugore utwite cyangwa wonsa mu bikorwa bya buri munsi ukamufasha muganira, gukinisha umwana akabikora nk’imikino nabyo byubaka ururimi, amarangamutima, imibanire ye n’abandi, igihagararo no gufata ibyemezo hakiri kare. Kuganiriza umwana, kumuterura, kumutemberana umwereka ibintu, kumuririmbira, kumubwira udukuru twigisha ibyiza ni ngombwa kuko umwana aba abikurikira.

Abarwayi b’indwara y’igituntu mu mwaka wa 20202021, 26.3% bazanywe n’abajyanama b’ubuzima; naho abarwayi bakurikiranwa nabo bakize ku kigero cya 93.3%. Umwitozo wo kwicaza uwagize ikibazo cy’ubuzima gitunguranye gikeneye ubutabazi bw’ibanze
Shyaka yari akiri muto cyane igihe cya jenoside kandi yabonye amahano yakozwe icyo gihe. Muri iyi minsi, yatangiye kuvuza induru nijoro no gukanguka ibyuya byamurenze. umugore we agerageza kumuhumuriza, ariko ahorana ubwoba. Arota ibintu biteye ubwoba yabonye akavuza induru, “Oya, winyica!” Shyaka ntashaka kuva mu rugo. Rimwe na rimwe aba afite ubwoba, imitsi yareze, kandi arikanga iyo yumvise ibintu bisakuza. Afite ubwoba bwinshi ku buryo atajya mu murima guhinga.

2.5.2. Intambwe ubujyanama buhabwa umukobwa cyangwa umugore ugiye gufatirwa igipimo cy’inkari gisuzumako atwite

Kudwingwa: ushyiraho igitambaro gitose, iyo agakoko kakuriye kasizemo urubori wihutira kurukuramo iyo hatarabyimba, iyo harangije kubyimba ururekeramo ukihutana umurwayi Kwa muganga. Ibibazo ku nda atwite
Gusobanurira umuryango ko kwa muganga ari ho hantu bashobora gukingira cyangwa gukemura ibibazo umugore ashobora guhura na byo mu gihe cyo kubyara.
Mukurikirane neza agakino mwandike ibyo mubona byose. Nyuma y’agakino musubize ibibazo bikurikira:
Gira ababyeyi inama yo kugumana isuku nk’uko twabibonye ku mpinja zisanzwe. Ariko ubibutse ko kubarinda indwara bigomba kwitonderwa kurusha uko bita ku mpinja zisanzwe
Ibintu by’ingenzi ugomba kwitaho mugihe urimo gukora isuzuma ryibanze nibi bikurikira:
Hari impamvu nyinshi zitera kubaho kw’indwara cyangwa icyorezo. Indwara zituruka ku ruhurirane rw’agakoko gatera indwara kahuye n’umuntu ushobora kwandura kandi ukwandura kugafashwa cyane n’uruhurirane rw’ibidukikije bifasha ikwirakwizwa ry’ako gakoko kavuye ku muntu cyangwa inyamaswa kajya ku muntu cyangwa inyamanswa. Ubwuzuzanye bw’ibintu bitatu bikurikira nibwo tugiye kwifashisha dusobanura uburyo icyorezokibaho.

Umubyeyi ntagomba gutegereza ko umwana arira kugirango amwonse. Kurira ni ikimenyetso cya nyuma cy’uko umwana yashonje.
Umuryango mpuza ahanga wita ku buzima uvuga ko abantu bafite ubumuga badafite ubuzima bwiza muri rusange, uburezi buracyari hasi, amahirwe ni make mu bikorwa by’iterambere, ubukene buri hejuru ugerera je n’abantu badafite bumuga. Ibi byose bikaba biterwa cyane cyane no kubura kwa za serivisi zigenewe abafite ubumuga hamwe n’inzitizi bahura na zo mu buzima bwabo bwa buri munsi.
Naho umubare w’abana bapfa bataruzuza umwaka wavuye kuri 107 mu mwaka wa 2000 ugera kuri 33 ku bana 1000 bavutse ari bazima nk’uko byagaragajwe n’ubushakashatsi ku mibereho n’ubuzima mu Rwanda (DHS 2019/2020).
